book_title: 小蓝本高中卷9 不等式的解题与技巧
stem_md: 因为 $\sin(\alpha-\beta)\sin(\alpha+\beta)=\frac{1}{2}(\cos 2\beta-\cos 2\alpha)=\sin^2\alpha-\sin^2\beta$, 所以 $\sin a \sin(a-b)\sin(a-c)\sin(a+b)\sin(a+c)=\sin a(\sin^2a-\sin^2b)(\sin^2a-\sin^2c)$. 令 $x=\sin^2a$, $y=\sin^2b$, $z=\sin^2c$, 则原不等式等价于 $x^{\frac{1}{2}}(x-y)(x-z) + y^{\frac{1}{2}}(y-z)(y-x) + z^{\frac{1}{2}}(z-x)(z-y) \geqslant 0$, 此即舒尔不等式.
solution_md: 由舒尔不等式知原不等式成立.
original_text_md: 21. 因为 $\sin(\alpha-\beta)\sin(\alpha+\beta)=\frac{1}{2}(\cos 2\beta-\cos 2\alpha)=\sin^2\alpha-\sin^2\beta$, 所以 $\sin a \sin(a-b)\sin(a-c)\sin(a+b)\sin(a+c)=\sin a(\sin^2a-\sin^2b)(\sin^2a-\sin^2c)$. 令 $x=\sin^2a$, $y=\sin^2b$, $z=\sin^2c$, 则原不等式等价于 $x^{\frac{1}{2}}(x-y)(x-z) + y^{\frac{1}{2}}(y-z)(y-x) + z^{\frac{1}{2}}(z-x)(z-y) \geqslant 0$, 此即舒尔不等式. 由舒尔不等式知原不等式成立.
